---
title: Cuttlefish Risotto
id: MAR-0106
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 75
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 400 g cuttlefish
- 280 g rice
- 1 l fish stock
- 30 g dried mushroom
- 1 onion
- 1 carrot
- 0.5 celery stalk
- 1 tablespoon parsley
- 250 g tomato pulp
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 10 g butter
## Method
1. Soak the mushrooms in a cup of warm water for 15 minutes.
2. Peel the onion and dice it.
3. Clean the celery stalk from leaves and strings and slice it.
4. Scrape the carrot under running water and dice it.
5. Heat the oil and sauté the prepared vegetables and the squeezed mushrooms.
6. After 5 minutes add the tomato pulp and parsley and let cook for 10 minutes.
7. Add the cuttlefish cut into strips and let cook for 40 minutes, moistening with a little broth if necessary.
8. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for a minute.
9. Pour the boiling broth one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
10. Add the cuttlefish, mix, and serve.
